notes.title: Notice for Online Lobby Functions Ending
notes.content:
As of 28 Feb 2022, the online lobby feature in One Punch Man: A Hero Nobody Knows will be closed down. 

Along with the ending of online lobby functions, the following features will no longer be available:
- Participation in Online Events
- Participation in Avatar Ranked Battles
- Distribution of login bonuses

You will still be able to join our no-hair hero and all his friends & foes in all the offline modes the game has to offer, as well as challenge a friend in an online 1vs1 match.

notes.title: Patch Version 1.001 Released
notes.content:
A new patch has just been released for ONE PUNCH MAN: A HERO NOBODY KNOWS.
Update v1.001 includes the following:

[list][*] Added “Town FPS” option to the Town Menu.
[*] Adjusted English voice volume during various dialogues in the game.
[*] Updated default keyboard controls.[/list]
